topic: How does the 41% efficiency of the proposed antenna impact link budget calculations for GEO-LEO satellite links?
consensus_response: The 41% efficiency of the proposed antenna in GEO-LEO links reduces the Effective Radiated Power (ERP) by 59%, necessitating higher transmit power from the satellite, increasing operational costs, and potentially leading to higher interference levels in the uplink. This necessitates advanced network management strategies, such as dynamic power allocation and interference coordination, to optimize resource utilization and maintain service quality. The array factor and spatial diversity benefits of LEO satellites can partially mitigate these issues, but the overall capacity and interference environment will still be compromised.
reference_context: The discussion revolves around the impact of a 41% efficient antenna on link budget calculations for GEO-LEO satellite links. Experts from the DLB and PNM perspectives have highlighted the significance of reduced ERP and increased transmit power, necessitating advanced network management strategies to balance the trade-offs between efficiency and performance.
